picks.excerpt: Tencent's WorldClaw generates an entire editable 3D world from a text prompt rather than a flat video clip — a demo of prompt-to-set that lands closer to previs and virtual production than to text-to-video.
picks.rationale: Prompt-to-editable-3D-world moves generative AI out of the flat-clip trap and straight into previs/virtual-production territory.

picks.excerpt: Joseph Bell's third annual free VFX & Animation World Atlas charts 140,000+ artists at 2,900 companies, finds 2.7% net industry growth, and says the data shows no evidence AI has cut VFX jobs.
picks.rationale: A free, citable dataset on 2,900 studios that directly contradicts the AI-job-loss narrative — rare hard numbers in a debate run on vibes.

picks.excerpt: EditShare is bringing GPU-powered Flow AI processing into its EFS storage nodes at IBC, expanding AI-assisted transcription and search to 13 languages so post teams can hunt footage across international content from inside the MAM.
picks.rationale: AI transcription and search moving into the storage node means footage hunting happens where the media already lives — a concrete change to post workflow.

picks.excerpt: WildBrain is buying Personality AI, the company behind conversational 'Hey Peppa Pig' experiences, folding real-time GenAI character performance into a legacy kids IP catalogue.
picks.rationale: A major IP holder buying real-time conversational character tech outright signals where legacy catalogues are heading next.

picks.excerpt: Apple's new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra is pitched squarely at on-device AI, and No Film School digs into which of those gains actually reach video editors and colorists.
picks.rationale: Separates the on-device AI marketing from the gains that actually show up in an edit or grade — a real purchasing decision this quarter.
